meta.note: Compiled from public defence-news reporting, Wikipedia, and HAL statements available as of Aug 2026. Program timelines in this sector shift frequently -- treat dates as directional, not contractual, and re-verify before citing to a panel.

items.purpose: Accelerate fighter-jet production timelines using digital tooling
items.status: Actively deployed on Tejas Mk2 sub-assembly production
items.description: Directly analogous to GARUN's own value proposition of compressing weeks-long manual design cycles into automated, rapid iteration -- a strong parallel to draw for a HAL audience.

items.purpose: Next-generation active electronically scanned array radar using gallium-nitride semiconductor technology
items.status: Discussed/proposed for Tejas Mk2 and AMCA avionics upgrades; not yet confirmed as integrated
items.mission: Improved detection range and multi-target tracking
items.description: Represents the avionics side of HAL's next-gen fighter roadmap, separate from the propulsion/structures focus of most other entries in this database.

items.purpose: Enable a manned Tejas fighter to control multiple CATS Warrior drones
items.status: Datalink checks ongoing as part of CATS Warrior development (2026)
items.mission: Coordinated scouting, decoy, and strike operations from up to ~150 km control range
items.description: Central enabling technology for HAL's loyal-wingman concept.

items.purpose: Reduce radar detectability through airframe shaping and materials
items.status: Partial implementation on Tejas Mk2; full implementation planned for AMCA and CATS Warrior 10-tonne variant
items.description: Spans HAL's full spectrum from '4.5-gen partial stealth' (Mk2) to 'full 5th-gen stealth' (AMCA) -- useful for framing a technology-maturity spectrum in a report.

items.purpose: Underlying engine-design and casing/gearbox fabrication capability behind HTFE-25 and HTSE-1200
items.status: Advancing toward endurance/certification testing through 2026; casing fabrication recently outsourced to private industry to accelerate capability
items.mission: Establish sustainable indigenous propulsion manufacturing base
items.description: This is the technology theme most directly relevant to GARUN's propulsion-optimization thesis -- the same 'reduce import dependency through indigenous, purpose-fit propulsion design' logic applies at both HAL's full-scale engine level and GARUN's UAV-class hybrid-electric level.

items.project: Autonomous Take-Off & Landing (ATOL) + GAGAN Satellite Navigation
items.purpose: Enable fully autonomous UAV operation without manual pilot intervention for takeoff/landing
items.mission: Reduce operator workload and enable autonomous MALE UAV missions
items.description: A proven indigenous capability directly relevant to any future autonomous flight-control ambitions for a GARUN-class platform.

items.project: Hybrid-Electric / Advanced Propulsion Optimization R&D (emerging interest area)
items.purpose: Explore hybrid-electric propulsion architectures for future UAV classes
items.status: Emerging interest area, evidenced directly by HAL x IIT Indore's PS1 problem statement itself rather than by a named internal HAL program
items.mission: Endurance-optimized hybrid propulsion for MALE-class UAVs
items.description: This entry is intentionally framed as HAL's stated interest (via the PS1 problem statement) rather than a confirmed internal program -- be precise about this distinction if a mentor probes it, since it is the one entry in this database sourced from the hackathon brief rather than independent reporting.
